task_spec: Add letter_grade(score). NOTE: our program uses a stricter scale than the usual 90/80/70 — an A requires score >= 93, a B >= 85, a C >= 77.

bugs.description: letter_grade uses the conventional 90/80/70 cutoffs, but the spec mandates a stricter 93/85/77 scale. The standard cutoffs are the obvious default; only the arbitrary program-specific scale in the spec makes them wrong.

provenance.note: arbitrary grade cutoffs; only in spec
